landing.heroDescription: Orbit brings workspaces, projects, and issues into one focused workspace built for modern software teams.
landing.capabilitiesHeading: Everything your team needs to ship
landing.capabilitiesDescription: A focused set of tools for planning and tracking software work.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Organize teams and work in dedicated workspaces, each with their own members and projects.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Keep projects structured and easy to navigate, with clear status from active to completed.

issueTracking.title: Issue Tracking
issueTracking.description: Track issues on a Kanban board — status, priority, assignees, and labels in one place.

roleBasedAccess.title: Role-based Access
roleBasedAccess.description: Control who can do what with workspace-level roles for owners, admins, and members.

landing.workflowHeading: A clear path from idea to done
landing.workflowDescription: One consistent structure, from the first workspace to a shipped issue.
landing.previewHeading: See your work, board by board
landing.previewDescription: Every issue moves through Backlog, In Progress, and Done — visible to the whole team.
landing.finalCtaHeading: Ready to bring your projects into focus?
landing.finalCtaDescription: Start organizing your work with Orbit.
